defect_fixed.previous_behavior: empty OR missing OR count-only all collapse to sha256("0") = 5feceb66ffc86f38d952786c6d696c79c2dbc239dd4e91b46729d73a27fb57e9

states.EMPTY_COLLECTION: container element exists but zero records
states.MISSING_COLLECTION: no container element anywhere in the document
states.PARSE_FAILURE: XML parse failure; digest field = 'PARSE_FAILURE:<TAG>' and parse_failure=true

record_canonicalization.validities: sorted tuple of (lane, from, to, direction, side)
record_canonicalization.ordering: records sorted by flat serialization string (document order does not affect digest)

discriminators.empty_vs_missing: state differs (EMPTY_COLLECTION vs MISSING_COLLECTION) -> digests differ
discriminators.empty_vs_parse_failure: PARSE_FAILURE digest is a sentinel string, not a hex sha256 of an empty payload
discriminators.adding_one_reference: count changes 0->1 and record appended -> reference digest and combined digest change
discriminators.adding_one_controller: same for controller digest and combined digest
discriminators.semantic_mutation: any record field change alters the record flat string -> digest changes
discriminators.canonical_ordering: sorted records -> reordering XML elements does not change the digest
